race.description: Mountain View Hotel Tooraweenah Cup Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: MY ANGEL SHELL (3) raced on the speed last start and battled on well but found one better over 1600m at Coonabarabran. Going well enough to take this out. CASTERLY ROCK (1) wasn't far away last time out, finishing third over 1400m at Warren. Won't be bothered by this longer journey. Poses a genuine threat. SUNDAY (2) ran a better race last start to finish a close second over 1400m at Dubbo after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Finds the right race this time and can take the next step and salute. PHILS COLOURS (4) ran a better race when second up last start, finishing fifth at Cowra. Reunites with Jacob Stiff who has three wins from four rides. Worth including in calculations.
